WELCOME TO MARKET DRAYTON TOWN, 
BEN MAGINNESS! 🔴🔵⚪️

Market Drayton Town are delighted to announce the signing of Ben Maginness, who joins the club on dual registration from Hanley Town.

Ben arrives at the Balufab Stadium with an impressive footballing background.

He has previously been involved with both Derby County and Burton Albion’s youth setups, before going on to captain Kidderminster Harriers U21s.

Ben then enjoyed a loan spell with Coleshill Town at Step 4, gaining valuable experience in senior non-league football.

He went on to have a successful season with Hanley Town, playing his part in their title-winning campaign last season, before also featuring for them at Step 4 this season.

We’re delighted to welcome Ben to Market Drayton Town and look forward to seeing him in a Drayton shirt.

Welcome to the club Ben! 👊

🗣️ LLoydy on the signing of Ben
I’m really pleased to get Ben Maginness through the door on dual registration from Hanley Town.

Ben is a very talented defender who can play right across the back line and has gained some really good experience with both Hanley and Kidderminster. As soon as I knew there was an opportunity to bring him into Drayton, I did everything I could to make it happen because I think he’ll be a massive addition to the group.

He’s also got really good leadership qualities. He captained Kidderminster’s Under-21s and played a lot of football last season in a Step 5 title-winning side, so he knows what it takes to be part of a successful dressing room.

He comes straight into the squad for Saturday and I’m really looking forward to seeing what he can bring to us.

I’d also like to say a massive thank you to Scott and everyone at Hanley Town for helping us get the dual registration sorted. It’s really appreciated and hopefully it’s a move that works well for everyone involved.
